title: On the list version of a conjecture of Erdős and Neumann-Lara
summary: The dichromatic number of a digraph $D$, denoted by $\vecχ(D)$, is the smallest number of colours required to colour the vertices of $D$ such that each colour class induces an acyclic digraph. A conjecture of Erdős and Neumann-Lara states that there exists a function $f(k)$ such that for every graph $G$ with $χ(G) \geq f(k)$ there is an orientation of $G$ such that the resulting digraph $D$ satisfies $\vecχ(D) \geq k$.
